errors.bad_ref: the session snapshot's task, agent or session id has characters it cannot have
errors.no_agent_to_resume: stage {stage} has no agent assigned to resume it
errors.no_store: this daemon has no directory for session snapshots
errors.not_a_resume_kind: {kind} is not a resume: use answer_resume or changes_resume
errors.snapshot_not_found: no session snapshot for that task, agent and session
errors.snapshot_too_large: the session snapshot is over {max} bytes; the next resume starts from the transcript

log.remove_group: remove the session snapshots of group {group}
log.remove_old: remove the old session snapshot {name} in {dir}
log.transcript_engine: build the transcript: no parser for engine {engine}

transcript.title:
# Earlier conversation with {agent} on this task

What this agent did in earlier runs (the tools it called and how each run ended) and what people wrote to it, oldest first. It is context: the task brief and the repository are the source of truth.
